phase1_phase3_creative_20261030.phase1_3_hero_isolation: NEW Northstar_backend/listing_image.py: cutout -> pure white (255,255,255) hero, subject at the requested fill, deterministic ellipse contact shadow. phase1_phase3_creative_20261030.phase3_1_render_bind: NEW Northstar_backend/render_bind.py: margin decides the material tier (>=55% premium kraft+foil+spot UV, 35-55% standard coated board, <35% value uncoated kraft+flexo) and prompt_suffix() appends the substrate/finish/lighting clause to every prompt. Missing cost or price -> tier=unknown + pricing_unknown blocker, never a zero. Lifestyle on a value-margin product refused as lifestyle_over_budget. Keywords normalised/deduped/capped at 20. 18 tests.
phase1_phase3_creative_20261030.phase3_2_asset_handoff: NEW Northstar_backend/asset_handoff.py: brief + asset manifest -> Listing Forge payload (hero URL, hero aspect, secondary by role capped at 6, keywords, alt text with no claims). Refuses a hero that is not pure-white or not square; drops assets without a URL; propagates brief blockers so a pricing-unknown product cannot become a listing draft. 11 tests.
phase1_phase3_creative_20261030.phase3_3_brand_memory: NEW Northstar_backend/brand_memory.py: validated hex colours, heading/body fonts, logo ref + placement, up to 10 winning prompts -> memory atoms that are ALWAYS status=proposed. No code path returns 'applied' - the revision gate is intact. 13 tests.
